relationships.subject: CGRP+ nociceptive afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the monkey 5-HT+ raphespinal tract, TH+ cerulospinal tract, and CGRP+ unmyelinated peptidergic nociceptive afferents grew into grafts and formed synapses with human neurons

key_findings: Grafted hPSC-derived spinal dI4 GABA neurons survived 7.5 months in T10-hemisected rhesus macaque spinal cord, matured (KCC2, GAD67 expression), and formed inhibitory synapses with host dorsal horn neurons.
T10 hemisection in macaques produced locomotor deficits, contralateral mechanical allodynia and ipsilateral spasm.
